    Gradings carried by a representable poset-space realization #

    The frozen manuscript grades the factor category by path length and then grades each represented total space Hom(P, X) by the same homogeneous Hom components. The chosen maps P ⟶ P_t are homogeneous. Composition therefore makes every distinguished subspace

    image (Hom(P_t, X) ⟶ Hom(P, X))

    homogeneous, so the represented poset space acquires the compatible internal grading used in the concentration argument.
